itemmilestonelog.configuration.allowDisc: Allow players to opt out of Discord posts with /milestonelog discordoptout. When false, the command is disabled and saved preferences are ignored (but preserved).
itemmilestonelog.configuration.allowLook: Allow every player to view other players' records with /milestonelog lookup <player>. When false, only operators (and the singleplayer/LAN host) can look others up; looking yourself up always works.
itemmilestonelog.configuration.announceP: Announce to all online players when someone completes all targets of a preset. When false, only the completing player is notified (if notifyPlayer is enabled).
itemmilestonelog.configuration.announceW: Announce server-wide world-first records to all online players.
itemmilestonelog.configuration.autoBacku: Back up MilestoneData to <world>/itemmilestonelog/backups/ on world save (at most once per hour) and on server stop. Independent of exportImportEnabled.
Maximum number of automatic backup files to keep per world (1-20).
itemmilestonelog.configuration.broadcast: Broadcast milestone records to all online players in addition to the player themself.
itemmilestonelog.configuration.chatItemH: Show the item when hovering an item name in this mod's chat messages. Tag targets show the first item of the tag by registry ID; the text itself is unchanged.
itemmilestonelog.configuration.defaultTa: Item IDs that every player tracks by default, e.g. minecraft:diamond or minecraft:diamond#100 for a quantity. Players can add their own targets on top of these.
itemmilestonelog.configuration.discordDi: Send a periodic Discord digest of milestones recorded since the previous digest. Uses the Discord webhook, scope, embed, and language settings.
Interval in days between Discord digest messages (1-30).
itemmilestonelog.configuration.discordLa: Language for Discord webhook notifications (en_us or ja_jp).
itemmilestonelog.configuration.discordNo: Post preset completions to Discord when a webhook URL is configured. Independent of announcePresetCompletion and discordNotifyScope.
Which milestones to send to Discord: all or world_first.
itemmilestonelog.configuration.discordSi: Send normal (non-world-first) milestone posts to Discord without triggering notifications. Does not affect world-first posts, groups containing a world first, preset completions, digests, or the test command.
itemmilestonelog.configuration.discordUs: Send Discord milestone notifications as rich embeds instead of plain text.
itemmilestonelog.configuration.displayTi: Timezone ID used for server-formatted dates (chat, log, Discord, exports). Leave empty for the server default; examples: UTC, Asia/Tokyo, +09:00. The GUI always uses the player's local timezone.
itemmilestonelog.configuration.exportImp: Enable milestone export and import commands (applies to OPs as well).
itemmilestonelog.configuration.firstJoin: Preset IDs applied automatically as personal targets the first time a player joins this world. Leave empty to disable; players can remove the applied targets.
itemmilestonelog.configuration.groupSimu: Group notifications when 3 or more milestones are recorded for the same player in the same tick. Set to false to send every record immediately.
itemmilestonelog.configuration.guiWorldF: Show a star mark (★) on recorded milestones in the GUI for which you hold the world first.
itemmilestonelog.configuration.ignoreCre: Do not record anything while a player is in creative or spectator mode. Items still carried when switching back to survival are not recorded either until they leave the inventory.
itemmilestonelog.configuration.itemToolt: Show milestone status lines at the end of item tooltips on this client. This is a client-side display setting controlled by each player's own config file.
itemmilestonelog.configuration.loginWorl: Send a chat summary when a player logs in, listing world firsts recorded while they were away. Requires a stored last-seen time and is skipped while muteBroadcasts is enabled. Shows up to 5 entries plus the remaining count.
itemmilestonelog.configuration.milestone: Optional server command to run (without a leading slash) when a milestone is recorded (empty = disabled). Supports player, UUID, item, count, playtime, and world-first placeholders; use a function command for multiple commands.
Sound event ID to play when a milestone is recorded.
Play a sound to the player when a milestone is recorded (independent of notifyPlayer).
itemmilestonelog.configuration.notifyPla: Send the player a chat message when one of their target items is recorded.
itemmilestonelog.configuration.presetsEn: Enable preset commands and preset management in the GUI. Existing preset files are never deleted.
itemmilestonelog.configuration.progressA: Minimum target quantity required for progress alerts (2-1000000).
Percentage thresholds (1-99) at which to send progress alerts for quantity targets. Duplicates are ignored and values are evaluated in ascending order. Leave empty to disable.
Notify the player in chat when a quantity target crosses a progress threshold (independent of notifyPlayer).
itemmilestonelog.configuration.scanInter: Inventory scan interval in ticks (20 ticks = 1 second). Lower is more precise but slightly more expensive.
itemmilestonelog.configuration.scoreboar: Optional scoreboard objective name for each player's milestone record count (empty = disabled). Use a dedicated name matching ^[A-Za-z0-9_.+-]{1,32}$; clearing this setting does not delete existing objectives or scores.

Optional scoreboard objective name for each player's world-first count (empty = disabled). Must match ^[A-Za-z0-9_.+-]{1,32}$ and differ from scoreboardObjective; clearing this setting does not delete existing objectives or scores.
itemmilestonelog.configuration.showFirst: Show a one-time chat tip when a player joins for the first time.
itemmilestonelog.configuration.strictPre: Reject a config-folder or datapack preset entirely when any element fails validation, instead of skipping only the invalid elements. Includes failures and invalid groups also reject it; built-in presets are never rejected.

itemmilestonelog.configuration.worldFirs: Record new server-wide world-first milestones. Existing world-first records are kept and can still be viewed.
